guide.title: Quick Start Guide
guide.description: Learn step by step how to structure your information to get the most out of the Nexum platform and highlight your professional profile.
guide.step1_desc: The first step to stand out on Nexum is to complete your basic personal information. Go to the My Profile section and make sure to add:
guide.step1_bullet1: A professional profile picture, with good lighting and clear framing.
guide.step1_bullet2: Your current role or title (e.g., 'Software Engineer' or 'Computer Science Student').
guide.step1_bullet3: A brief executive biography summarizing your experience, professional goals, and passions.
guide.step1_bullet4: Your professional networks in the 'Links' tab (primarily LinkedIn and GitHub).
guide.step2_desc: Your projects are the tangible evidence of your capabilities. To successfully document a project:
guide.step2_bullet1: Access the Projects section in the sidebar menu of your Dashboard.
guide.step2_bullet2: Click on 'New project' to open the form.
guide.step2_bullet3: Write a clear title and description explaining what problem you solved and what your role was.
guide.step2_bullet4: Accurately select the technologies and programming languages used.
guide.step2_bullet5: Key tip: Attach high-resolution screenshots or architecture diagrams to visually enrich the presentation of your work.
guide.step3_desc: Build technical and professional credibility by adding your background to the system:
guide.step3_skills_desc: Browse our centralized catalog and select your technical (Hard Skills) and soft competencies (Soft Skills).
guide.step3_exp_desc: Register internships, formal jobs, or research roles, chronologically detailing your responsibilities and achievements.
guide.step3_cert_desc: Upload evidence of courses, workshops, or international certifications that validate your knowledge.
guide.step4_desc: Once data entry is complete, the Nexum engine is ready to generate your documents:
guide.step4_bullet1: Go to the 'My Portfolio' section to preview how your unified profile looks.
guide.step4_bullet2: Use the 'Export PDF' button to instantly generate a formatted resume or portfolio ready to print or email to recruiters.
guide.step4_bullet3: Optionally, be sure to change your visibility settings in 'Privacy' so you can share your public profile URL on professional networks.

pdf.title: PDF Format and Tips
pdf.description: Best practices and technical recommendations to ensure Nexum export engine generates a flawless document.
pdf.tip1_desc: The PDF generator takes photos directly from your web portfolio. To avoid pixelation or distortion in the printed version:
pdf.tip1_bullet1: Upload a profile photo with a neutral background and good lighting (1:1 format recommended).
pdf.tip1_bullet2: Project screenshots should be in 16:9 widescreen ratio and not exceed 2MB per image.
pdf.tip2_desc: An effective resume is visually scanned in seconds. Nexum PDF format is optimized for quick reading:
pdf.tip2_bullet1: Limit your main biography to a maximum of 2 or 3 short paragraphs (approx. 500 characters).
pdf.tip2_bullet2: In work experience, use bullet points to list your achievements instead of dense text blocks.
pdf.tip3_desc: The system has different graphic design structures (templates) programmed to accommodate the volume of your information. Currently available:
pdf.classic_desc: Ideal for profiles with extensive experience and certifications. Prioritizes sequential reading and minimizes space used by images.
pdf.modern_desc: Focused on developers and designers. Prominently highlights project thumbnails and uses a two-column structure.

rules.title: Rules and Privacy
rules.description: General guidelines for the proper use of the Nexum platform and transparent handling of your professional information.
rules.sec1_desc: Nexum is an institutional platform of academic and professional nature managed by Universidad Mayor de San Simón. By registering and using our services, you agree to comply with the following provisions:
rules.sec1_bullet1_desc: You must provide accurate, current, and complete data about your identity, academic background, and professional career.
rules.sec1_bullet2_desc: You agree not to upload copyrighted content without authorization (e.g., private corporate source code, confidential documents, or copyrighted images).
rules.sec1_bullet3_desc: You are required to maintain respectful and strictly professional language in descriptions, projects, and any public interaction within the system.
rules.sec2_desc: The protection of your data is fundamental. You have absolute control over what information you wish to share and with whom:
rules.sec2_bullet1_desc: Upon account creation, your portfolio is hidden. No external user or search engine can access your information without your explicit authorization.
rules.sec2_bullet2_desc: If you choose to set your profile as public, your basic information will be indexed in our directory. You can granularly configure which specific sections (Projects, Skills, Certifications) to show or hide.
rules.sec2_bullet3_desc: Sensitive information such as your personal phone number or alternative email will be strictly hidden, unless you activate the 'Show contact information' feature in your settings.
rules.sec3_desc1: Nexum administration reserves the right to audit public-status portfolios to ensure the integrity and quality of the institutional directory.
rules.sec3_desc2: Temporary suspension or permanent termination will apply to accounts that:
rules.sec3_bullet1: Violate university regulations by sharing fraudulent, misleading, or inappropriate content.
rules.sec3_bullet2: Receive verifiable reports of identity theft or misappropriation of third-party academic projects.
rules.sec3_note: Note: These regulations may be subject to periodic updates to adapt to new institutional requirements. Any substantial change will be promptly notified via a notice on the main dashboard.

faq.title: How can we help you?
faq.search_placeholder: Search for a topic or keyword (e.g., PDF, hide, password)...
faq.contact_box_desc: Our support team is ready to help you.
faq.q1: What is Nexum and what is it for?
faq.a1: Nexum is the institutional platform of Universidad Mayor de San Simón designed for students and professionals to create, manage, and share their digital portfolio, highlighting their projects, skills, and experience to potential recruiters.
faq.q2: Who can register on the platform?
faq.a2: Currently, registration is open to students and professionals linked to the Faculty of Science and Technology of UMSS. Use your institutional or personal email to create an account.
faq.q3: I forgot my password, how do I recover it?
faq.a3: On the login screen, click 'Forgot your password?'. Enter your email and we will send you a secure link to reset it.
faq.q4: Why doesn't a specific technology appear in the Skills list?
faq.a4: The skills catalog is centrally managed to maintain consistency. If you cannot find a skill, use the 'Suggest Skill' option in the search. Administrators will review it to add it.
faq.q5: How many projects can I upload?
faq.a5: There is no limit to the number of projects you can register, but there is a total storage limit (MB) for attached files (images and PDFs) you upload in each project.
faq.q6: How do I share my portfolio with recruiters?
faq.a6: Go to 'Settings > Links and Privacy' and change your profile visibility to 'Public'. The system will generate a unique link that you can copy and send.
faq.q7: Can I hide certain sections of my portfolio?
faq.a7: Yes. In the Privacy section, you can independently configure whether you want to show or hide your Projects, Skills, Work Experience, or Certifications to the public.
faq.a8: Your contact details (phone and email) are hidden by default. You must explicitly enable the 'Show contact' switch in the Privacy settings if you want recruiters to see them.
faq.q9: How do I generate my resume PDF file?
faq.a9: On your main dashboard, click on 'Portfolio View'. In the upper right, you will find the 'Export PDF' button. You can choose between different templates.
faq.q10: Why does my PDF look cut off or low quality?
faq.a10: The PDF is generated based on the images you uploaded. We recommend using high-quality images (16:9 format) and keeping your biographies and descriptions concise so the document looks professional.
